name: MTN Eswatini Lobamba Data Centre
notes: Data-centre directory listings identify an MTN Eswatini facility at Lobamba; MTN Eswatini officially markets co-location and hosting services, but public source did not disclose capacity.

name: Central Bank of Eswatini Complex Data Centre
notes: Central Bank progress update for the Ezulwini complex reports data-centre building works at 73% completion as of 18 June 2025; no IT load or commissioning date disclosed.

name: RSTP National Data Centre
notes: RSTP official page describes the National Data Centre's data storage and business continuity services; third-party listings place it at Phocweni in the Manzini region. Capacity was not publicly disclosed.

name: MTN Eswatini Matsapha Data Centre
notes: Directory and Africa data-centre inventory sources list an MTN Eswatini data centre in Matsapha; MTN Eswatini official materials confirm co-location and hosting services, but public capacity details were not found.
